scenarios.title: Key Moment: Shoot or Pass?
scenarios.text: Saturday, 71st minute, score level. {J} breaks through on the left side of the box. The keeper comes off his line. {T} is unmarked at the far post, screaming for it.
scenarios.prompt: Split second. What do you do?

choices.label: Shoot
choices.hint: Glory or a missed chance everyone remembers.

ok.text: {J} shoots before the keeper sets his feet. Near post. The net bulges. The stadium shakes.

bad.text: {J} shoots. The keeper spreads himself and saves. {T} throws his arms in the air at the far post.

choices.label: Square it
choices.hint: The safer goal — if the pass is right.

ok.text: {J} draws the keeper and rolls it across. {T} taps into an empty net and runs straight to {J}.

bad.text: The pass is a fraction behind {T}. The defender recovers. Chance gone.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Penalty!
scenarios.text: Saturday, 84th minute, 1-1. Penalty. The regular taker is off the pitch. Somebody has to take it. The ball is lying on the grass and nobody is picking it up. {J} looks at it.

choices.label: Take it: power
choices.hint: Brave. If it's saved, everyone remembers.

ok.text: {J} smashes it straight down the middle as the keeper dives left. Goal. He doesn't celebrate, just walks back with his fist clenched.

bad.text: The keeper stays big and blocks it with his legs. Fifteen thousand people groan at once.

ok.text: Side-foot, bottom corner, keeper the wrong way. {J} kisses the badge.

bad.text: Too close to the keeper. He guesses right and pushes it round the post.

choices.label: Hand it to a teammate
choices.hint: No hero moment. No villain moment.

out.text: {T} scores. {J} is first to hug him.
{T} misses. Some fans wonder why {J} didn't take it.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Play Through the Pain?
scenarios.text: Saturday, 30th minute. A heavy challenge catches {J} on the thigh. The physio sprays it, rubs it, asks the question with his eyebrows: can you continue?

out.text: {J} stays on and grinds through it. A brave performance; a sore week.
Ten minutes later the thigh seizes completely. He goes off anyway, and now it's worse.

choices.label: Signal to come off
choices.text: {J} signals to the bench. The sub comes on. The thigh is fine by Tuesday.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Go Down or Stay Up?
scenarios.text: Saturday, 88th minute, 0-0. {J} dribbles into the box and a defender clips his heel. Barely. He could go down. He could also stay up and try to shoot from a tight angle.

ok.text: {J} rides the challenge and slots it under the keeper from a tight angle. The pundits talk about his honesty and his finish.

bad.text: {J} stays up, loses his balance, and the chance is gone.

choices.label: Go down
choices.hint: Penalty — or a yellow for diving.

out.text: Penalty given. The teammate scores. The opposition fans call {J} every name under the sun.
The referee waves a yellow card. Simulation. The replay is mocked on every highlights show.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Press or Hold Your Position?
scenarios.text: Saturday, 60th minute. The opposition centre-back takes a heavy touch. {J} could sprint to press him and maybe win it high — or hold the shape {M} drilled all week.

choices.label: Press
choices.hint: Win it high — or leave a hole behind you.

ok.text: {J} steals it off his toes and slips a pass into the box. Goal. The kind of moment coaches build a whole week around.

bad.text: The defender plays round him. Two passes later the ball is in {J}'s team's net. {M} throws his notes on the ground.

choices.label: Hold the shape
choices.text: {J} holds position. Nothing happens. {M} nods at the touchline.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Last Man
scenarios.text: Saturday, 77th minute, 1-0 up. The striker is through, {J} is the last man, the keeper is too far out. Slide tackle or jockey him wide?

ok.text: {J} slides and takes ball, only ball. The stadium roars as if it were a goal. His teammates slap his head.

bad.text: He gets the man, not the ball. Straight red. Penalty. The longest walk of his career.

choices.label: Jockey him wide
choices.desc: Show him away from goal, buy time.
choices.hint: Smart defending, if your feet are quick.

ok.text: {J} shows him wide, wide, wider, until the covering defender arrives. Danger gone. Textbook.

bad.text: The striker cuts back inside and scores. {J} was too slow to turn.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The Corner
scenarios.text: Saturday, 90th minute, leading by one. The opposition's last corner. Their giant centre-back is coming forward, and {J} has the job of marking him.

ok.text: {J} rises above the giant and heads it clear to halfway. Final whistle. He's mobbed.

bad.text: The giant climbs over him and heads it in. {J} lies on the grass staring at the sky.

out.text: The referee sees nothing. The ball is cleared. Dark arts.
VAR sees everything. Penalty. Yellow card.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Penalty Against You
scenarios.text: Saturday, 65th minute. Penalty to the opposition. Their striker places the ball and stares at {J}. The keeper coach's notes said he goes to the keeper's right three times out of four.

out.text: {J} dives right and the ball is there. Saved! The goalkeeping coach punches the air on the bench.
The striker goes left. Of course he does.

ok.text: {J} waits until the last moment and pushes a nervous shot round the post. The striker can't believe it.

bad.text: The striker rolls it into the corner while {J} stands there. It looks worse than diving the wrong way.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: One-on-One
scenarios.text: Saturday, 52nd minute. A through ball splits the defence. Their winger is clean through. {J} is on his line.

ok.text: {J} charges out and smothers the ball at the winger's feet. Brave and perfectly timed.

bad.text: {J} arrives late and clips the winger. Penalty and a yellow card.

ok.text: The winger shoots low; {J} gets a strong hand down. Save of the week on the highlights show.

bad.text: The winger dinks it over him. Nothing to be done.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The High Ball
scenarios.text: Saturday, 89th minute, 1-0 up. A hopeful cross swings in towards the penalty spot. Bodies everywhere. {J} could come and claim it — or stay on his line.

choices.label: Come and claim it
choices.hint: Catch it and you end the game. Miss it and you lose it.

ok.text: {J} rises above everyone and catches it cleanly. He holds it until the referee blows for full time.

bad.text: He gets a fingertip, no more. The ball drops and the opposition bundle it in.

choices.label: Stay on your line
choices.desc: Let the defenders deal with it.

out.text: The centre-back heads it clear. Danger over.
Unmarked header from six yards. {M} asks later why {J} didn't come.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Free Kick, 22 Metres
scenarios.text: Saturday, 80th minute, 0-0. Free kick, twenty-two metres out, slightly right of centre. {J} and {T} stand over the ball.

choices.label: You: curl it over the wall

ok.text: Over the wall, dipping, top corner. The keeper doesn't move. That clip will be shown for years.

bad.text: The ball hits the wall and bounces harmlessly away. {T} shakes his head.

ok.text: The wall jumps, {J} rolls it short, {T} smashes it in. {M} is out of his seat.

bad.text: Half the team forgot the routine. The ball rolls to nobody.

out.text: {T} scores. {J} jumps on his back.
{T} skies it into the stands.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Counter-Attack, Three on Two
scenarios.text: Saturday, 75th minute. A clearance falls to {J} on halfway with open grass ahead. Three attackers against two defenders. The crowd rises.

ok.text: {J} burns past both defenders and finishes coolly. Sixty metres, one man, one goal.

bad.text: {J} runs into the second defender. The counter dies. Two teammates were free.

ok.text: One pass, perfectly weighted. {T} scores. Football can be simple.

bad.text: Overhit. The keeper collects. Groans.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Run the Clock Down?
scenarios.text: Saturday, 89th minute, 1-0 up. The ball goes out for a throw near the corner flag. The bench is screaming at {J} to take his time.
scenarios.prompt: How do you see it out?

out.text: {J} takes forty seconds over a throw-in and the clock runs down. Ugly, effective.
Yellow card for time-wasting. That's a suspension closer.

ok.text: {J} keeps the ball in the corner for a minute, shielding it, winning a free kick. The fans love it.

bad.text: He loses it. A late counter, a late equaliser. Agony.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Provoked
scenarios.text: Saturday, 55th minute. The opposition's hard man has been kicking {J} all game. Now he stands on his ankle after the whistle and whispers something about his mother.

choices.label: Walk away
choices.desc: Don't give him what he wants.
choices.text: {J} walks away. Ten minutes later, the hard man gets booked for something else. Patience wins.

out.text: Both booked. Handbags. The referee warns them both.
The hard man falls like he's been shot. Red card for {J}. Ten men.

choices.label: Tell the referee
choices.desc: Let the officials deal with it.

out.text: The referee speaks to the hard man. The kicking stops.
The referee waves him away. The kicking continues.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: One-on-One With the Full-Back
scenarios.text: Saturday, 40th minute. {J} receives on the touchline, one-on-one with the full-back. The crowd wants him to take him on. {M} wants the ball recycled.

ok.text: Step-over, drop of the shoulder, gone. {J}'s cross is headed in. The stadium chants his name.

bad.text: The full-back reads it and takes ball and man. Counter-attack. {M} is not happy.

choices.label: Recycle possession
choices.text: {J} plays it back. Some fans whistle. {M} applauds.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Space at Thirty Metres
scenarios.text: Saturday, 67th minute. The ball sits up nicely thirty metres from goal. Nobody closes {J} down. A shot? A switch of play?

choices.label: Hit it
choices.hint: Goal of the season, or row Z.

ok.text: {J} catches it perfectly. It swerves, dips, kisses the underside of the bar and goes in. Pandemonium.

bad.text: Row Z. The fans behind the goal duck. {M} turns away.

ok.text: A forty-metre diagonal lands on the winger's chest. Two touches later it's a goal.

bad.text: Slightly overhit, out for a throw.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Injury-Time Set Piece
scenarios.text: Saturday, 94th minute, 0-1 down. Last free kick. {M} sends everyone forward, keeper included. The ball is about to be swung into the box.

ok.text: {J} gets there first and glances it into the far corner. 1-1 in the 94th minute. Chaos.

bad.text: {J} gets there first and flicks it wide by inches.

out.text: The ball drops from a scramble. {J} volleys it through a forest of legs. Equaliser!
Nothing drops. Final whistle.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The Team Is Collapsing
scenarios.text: Saturday, half-time, 0-2 down. Heads are down in the dressing room. {M} hasn't arrived yet. The players look at each other. Then they look at {J}.

ok.text: {J} speaks for one minute. The second half is the best football the team has played all season.

bad.text: The words don't land. The second half is the same as the first.

choices.label: Stay calm and tactical
choices.text: {J} goes round the room fixing one detail with each player. It helps.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Monsoon Football
scenarios.text: Saturday. The rain arrives just before kick-off, heavy as stones. Puddles form in the centre circle. The ball stops dead in the water. The referee decides to play on.

choices.label: Go long and direct
choices.text: {J} keeps it simple and direct. The opposition, still trying to pass, drown.

ok.text: {J} dribbles through puddles like they aren't there. A masterclass in mud.

bad.text: The ball stops in a puddle mid-dribble and he falls flat on his face. The clip goes viral, unkindly.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Derby Day Nerves
scenarios.text: Saturday is derby day. The city has talked about nothing else all week. In the tunnel, {J} can hear the noise through the concrete walls. His hands are shaking slightly.
scenarios.prompt: How do you handle the occasion?

ok.text: {J} plays like the noise is fuel. Every tackle is cheered like a goal.

bad.text: The first ten minutes are a blur of nerves and misplaced passes. He recovers, but too late.

choices.label: Block it out
choices.text: {J} breathes slowly, focuses on his first three actions, and plays a calm, steady game.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: A Terrible Refereeing Decision
scenarios.text: Saturday, 70th minute. A clear foul on {J} in the box, waved away. Then a soft penalty given at the other end. The players surround the referee. {J} is closest.
scenarios.prompt: What do you say to the referee?

choices.label: Nothing — walk away
choices.text: {J} walks away. The captain does the arguing. {J} stays on the pitch.

out.text: Yellow card for dissent. Worth it, he thinks. The club disagrees.
Red card for dissent. He said one word too many.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The Open Goal
scenarios.text: Saturday, 35th minute. The keeper slips. The ball rolls across the six-yard box to {J}. An open goal, two metres away. The easiest chance of his life, which is exactly why it's terrifying.

ok.text: Side-foot, back of the net. He celebrates like it was a thirty-yarder. Why not.

bad.text: Somehow, impossibly, it hits the post and rolls out. The clip will haunt him.

ok.text: He smashes it into the roof of the net. The net nearly comes off its hooks.

bad.text: Over the bar from two metres. The internet will not let him forget it.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Coming Off the Bench
scenarios.text: Saturday, 70th minute, 0-0. {M} calls {J} over. “Twenty minutes. Change the game.” He points at the pitch. The fourth official raises the board.

ok.text: Fresh legs against tired ones. {J} wins a corner, then a free kick, then scores from the rebound. Super sub.

bad.text: {J} runs a lot and achieves little. 0-0.

choices.label: Follow instructions exactly
choices.text: {J} does exactly what was asked. {M} gives him a thumbs-up at the final whistle.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Abuse From the Away End
scenarios.text: Saturday. Every time {J} takes a corner, the home fans behind the goal scream abuse — personal, ugly, some of it about where he comes from.

choices.label: Report it to the referee
choices.hint: The right thing. The game may be stopped.
choices.text: The referee stops the match and an announcement is made. The abuse stops. {J} plays on, shaken but proud.

ok.text: {J}'s next corner is headed in. He cups his ear to the stand. Silence.

bad.text: The abuse gets into his head. A poor afternoon.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The Back-Pass Under Pressure
scenarios.text: Saturday, 20th minute. A short back-pass from the centre-back, a little too soft. Their striker is sprinting in. {J} has a second.

choices.label: Clear it first time
choices.text: {J} launches it into the stand. Nobody claps. Nobody concedes.

ok.text: Touch, feint, pass. The striker slides past him into the advertising boards. {M} applauds.

bad.text: The striker blocks the pass and walks the ball into the net. Nightmare.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Overlap or Stay Home?
scenarios.text: Saturday, 60th minute. The winger in front of {J} has the ball and space opening outside him. {J} could overlap — but their quick winger would be behind him.

ok.text: {J} bombs on, receives, and whips a cross onto the striker's head. Goal.

bad.text: The move breaks down. Their winger sprints into the space {J} left. Goal for them.

choices.label: Stay home
choices.text: {J} stays put. Their winger never gets a sniff all afternoon.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Tactical Foul?
scenarios.text: Saturday, 82nd minute, 1-0 up. Their playmaker turns in midfield with three teammates sprinting forward. {J} is the only one who can stop it. A tactical foul means a yellow card.

choices.label: Take one for the team
choices.text: {J} pulls him down and accepts the yellow without arguing. The counter is dead. {M} nods.

choices.label: Try to win it cleanly
choices.hint: Clean win or a goal against.

ok.text: {J} reads the pass and intercepts it cleanly. Crisis averted.

bad.text: {J} dives in and misses. The playmaker slips the pass through. 1-1.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Celebrate in Front of the Rivals?
scenarios.text: Saturday. If {J} scores against {R} — the club whose fans have abused him all week — the away end is right there. One celebration could become legend. Or a fine.
scenarios.prompt: If you score, how do you celebrate?

choices.label: In front of their fans
choices.hint: Legend, or a booking and a riot.

out.text: He scores. The finger to the lips in front of their fans becomes a T-shirt. A yellow card, and worth it.
He doesn't score. Their fans sing about him all afternoon.

choices.label: With your teammates
choices.text: No goal this time. But {J} plays a composed game, and the trap he avoided is not the story.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Opponent Down Injured
scenarios.text: Saturday, 70th minute. {J} is through on goal — but an opponent is lying on the ground behind him, clutching his head. Sportsmanship says kick it out.
scenarios.prompt: Kick it out or play on?

choices.label: Kick it out
choices.text: {J} kicks it out. The injured player is fine. The opposing fans applaud him.

ok.text: {J} scores. Technically fine. The pundits argue about it for a week.

bad.text: He misses, and looks bad doing it.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The First Big Tackle
scenarios.text: Saturday. It's {J}'s first real 50-50 since he lost his confidence. The ball is loose between him and their midfielder. Everyone is watching to see if he'll go in.

ok.text: {J} wins it cleanly. The crowd roars. Something switches on in his head.

bad.text: He loses it, and the midfielder runs away with the ball.

choices.label: Hold back
choices.text: {J} pulls out. Nobody says anything. Everyone noticed.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Empty Tank, 80th Minute
scenarios.text: Saturday, 80th minute. {J}'s legs are gone. Cramp is creeping into both calves. The bench is warming up a substitute but hasn't made the change.

choices.label: Ask for the sub
choices.desc: A fresh player helps the team.
choices.text: {J} signals. The sub comes on with fresh legs. {M} pats him on the back.

out.text: {J} grinds through the last ten minutes on pure will.
Exhausted, {J} loses his man on a late corner. Goal against.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The Killer Pass
scenarios.text: Saturday, 58th minute. {J} turns in midfield. Two options: the safe pass to the full-back, or a curling through ball between two centre-backs to the striker making his run.

choices.label: The killer ball
choices.hint: Assist of the season, or lost possession.

ok.text: The pass bends between the two centre-backs into the striker's stride. Goal. The pass is what people talk about afterwards.

bad.text: Intercepted. A counter-attack. {M} shouts something that rhymes with 'simple'.

choices.label: The safe pass
choices.text: Safe pass. Possession kept. The game goes on.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The Slow Ball Boy
scenarios.text: Saturday, 87th minute, 0-1 down. The ball goes out for a throw. The home ball boy is suspiciously slow to return it. Every second counts.

choices.label: Grab the ball from him
choices.hint: Could go viral for the wrong reasons.

out.text: {J} snatches it, takes a quick throw, and the attack leads to an equaliser.
The ball boy falls over dramatically. Yellow card. The clip is played on loop by the home club.

choices.label: Use a spare ball
choices.text: {J} grabs the spare ball from the cone and takes the throw. Quick and clean.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: On a Yellow, Facing Their Fastest Player
scenarios.text: Saturday, 65th minute. {J} is already on a yellow card. Their fastest winger is running straight at him. One mistimed tackle and he's off.

ok.text: Patience, positioning, no fouls. The winger gives up and passes backwards.

bad.text: Too careful: the winger skips past and crosses. Goal.

choices.label: Ask to be subbed
choices.text: {J} catches {M}'s eye. He's replaced two minutes later. No second yellow.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: A Debutant Is Free
scenarios.text: Saturday, 88th minute, 3-0 up. {J} is through on goal — but {K}, the seventeen-year-old debutant who came on five minutes ago, is unmarked beside him.
scenarios.prompt: Score yourself, or give the kid his first goal?

ok.text: {K} taps it in and bursts into tears. {J} lifts him off the ground. The fans give {J} a standing ovation.

bad.text: The kid is so surprised he miskicks it. Everyone laughs, including {K}.

ok.text: {J} scores. 4-0. {K} high-fives him, trying not to look disappointed.

bad.text: {J} misses. {K} stares at him.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The Ball Hits Your Hand
scenarios.text: Saturday, 75th minute. A scramble in the box. The ball bounces off {J}'s arm and drops perfectly at his feet, two metres from goal. The referee didn't see it. Nobody saw it, except {J}.

choices.label: Score
choices.hint: VAR exists. So does your conscience.

out.text: Goal. VAR checks, and somehow misses it. {J} celebrates quietly and doesn't sleep well.
Goal — disallowed by VAR for handball. He's booked for good measure.

choices.label: Stop and admit it
choices.text: {J} stops, raises his hand, tells the referee. Free kick out. Fair play award nominations follow.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The Rabona Cross
scenarios.text: Saturday, 3-0 up, 80th minute. {J} is on the right touchline, on his wrong foot. A rabona cross is possible. Unnecessary. Beautiful.

ok.text: The rabona cross lands on the striker's forehead. 4-0. The clip reaches fifty million people.

bad.text: The rabona sails out for a goal kick. {M} subs him off immediately.

choices.label: Simple cross
choices.text: Normal cross, cleared. Nobody remembers it.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The Target Man
scenarios.text: Saturday. The opposition striker is huge, experienced and dirty. All week the analysts showed clips of him elbowing defenders. First long ball: he's coming for {J}.

ok.text: A hard, fair first challenge. The striker looks at {J} differently after that. He doesn't win another header.

bad.text: Too hard, too early. Yellow card in the fifth minute. A long afternoon.

ok.text: {J} never lets him jump cleanly. Frustration, then a booking — for the striker.

bad.text: The striker wins everything in the air. A tough day.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: 93rd Minute, Ball at Your Feet
scenarios.text: Saturday, 93rd minute, 1-1. A loose ball on the edge of the box falls to {J}. Defenders closing in. One touch to set, or hit it first time?

ok.text: First time, low, through a crowd of legs, into the corner. 93rd minute winner. The bench empties onto the pitch.

bad.text: It hits a defender and loops away. Full time. A draw.

ok.text: A touch away from the defender, then a curler into the top corner. Winner.

bad.text: The touch is too heavy. A defender clears. Full time.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Your Free Kick
scenarios.text: Saturday, 63rd minute. A free kick in {J}'s favourite spot, just left of the D. He's the club's set-piece taker now. The wall shuffles. The keeper shouts.

ok.text: Keeper's side, top corner, the keeper still taking a step the wrong way. Perfect.

bad.text: The keeper isn't fooled. Easy save.

ok.text: Over the wall, dipping, in. Trademark. Signature. His.

bad.text: Into the wall.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Penalty, and It's Yours
scenarios.text: Saturday, 70th minute. Penalty. {J} is the designated taker now. He picks up the ball and the keeper starts his mind games: pointing, waving, smiling.

ok.text: Usual corner. Usual result. {J} doesn't even celebrate.

bad.text: The keeper has done his homework. Saved.

choices.label: Change it up
choices.desc: Go the other way this time.

ok.text: The keeper dives to {J}'s usual corner. The ball goes the other way.

bad.text: The change of routine throws {J}'s own rhythm. Wide.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Down to Ten Men
scenarios.text: Saturday, 40th minute. A teammate is sent off. Ten men, a whole half to survive. {M} is changing the shape and shouting at {J} to adjust.

choices.label: Run for two
choices.text: {J} runs fourteen kilometres. The ten men hold on. He can't walk properly for two days.

choices.label: Stay disciplined
choices.text: {J} holds the new shape perfectly. The analysts mention it on Monday.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Catch and Launch
scenarios.text: Saturday, 80th minute. {J} catches a corner. The opposition has committed everyone forward. One quick throw could start a counter.
scenarios.prompt: Quick throw or slow it down?

ok.text: A sixty-metre throw to the winger, who scores. An assist for the goalkeeper.

bad.text: The throw is intercepted. Danger again.

choices.label: Hold it, slow the game
choices.text: {J} holds the ball, lets the team reorganise. Calm.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Shin, Knee, Anything
scenarios.text: Saturday, 55th minute. A goalmouth scramble. The ball pinballs between legs. It might hit {J}. It might not. He can throw himself at it.

choices.label: Dive in head first
choices.hint: Goal, or a boot in the face.

out.text: Diving header from six inches. Ugly, brave, a goal.
A boot to the head. Concussion protocol. Off.
It drops to him. Tap-in.
The keeper smothers it. Nothing.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: A Fan Runs Onto the Pitch
scenarios.text: Saturday, 60th minute. A teenage fan jumps the barrier and sprints toward {J} wanting a selfie. Stewards are chasing him. He's crying with excitement.

choices.label: Take the selfie
choices.text: {J} takes the selfie and walks him to the stewards with an arm round his shoulder. The clip is everywhere.

choices.label: Point him back to the stewards
choices.text: {J} gently steers him back to the stewards. Afterwards, he sends the boy a signed shirt.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: The Keeper Is Off His Line
scenarios.text: Saturday, 65th minute. {J} receives forty metres out and glances up. The keeper is a long way off his line.

choices.label: Chip him
choices.hint: Goal of the year, or a turnover.

ok.text: The chip floats over the backpedalling keeper and drops under the bar. Goal of the year contender.

bad.text: Over the bar by a metre. So close it's somehow worse.

choices.label: Drive forward
choices.text: {J} drives forward and wins a corner. Nothing more.

scenarios.title: Key Moment: Scouts in the Stand
scenarios.text: Saturday. The national team coach is in the stand, according to the stadium announcer. Every player on the pitch knows it. Some will try too hard.

choices.label: Do your job
choices.desc: Exactly what made them notice you.
choices.text: {J} plays his normal, intelligent game. Afterwards, his phone has a message from the national team staff.

out.text: A moment of genius: a goal that would make anyone's highlight reel.
Trying too hard, {J} loses the ball repeatedly. The national coach leaves at half-time.
